decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family that fits the firm's coordinated product system faces no reported shortfall against aspiration, and an established handle maker has the slack to carry it while results remain uncertain.
The mitred family extends the firm's architecture-aware design range, and with no evidence of a performance shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search, so it stays.
A multifunctional handle supports the strategic push toward barrier-free and hygiene solutions, so it is likely judged satisfactory and carried by existing slack.
A single new lever handle with only a basic website mention gives little sign of underperformance, and the low cost of keeping it in a broad range favours retention.
The FSB 1289 collection won the 2023 German Design Award and has its own page, so it clearly exceeds aspirations and will be kept.
A finish option uses the firm's in-house finishing capabilities across many products at low marginal cost, so without a shortfall signal it is retained.
